string.text: Camera height at which borders start to become visible. Lower values make borders appear when zoomed in closer. [Default: 30]
Camera height at which borders reach full opacity. [Default: 300]
Key to toggle border visibility on/off. [Default: M]
Width of each kingdom's border strip in world units. [Default: 1.05]
Gap between two adjacent kingdom border strips. [Default: 0.30]
How far above the terrain surface the border is raised. Increase if borders clip into mountains. [Default: 0.55]
Renders borders over water surfaces. [Default: disabled]
Resolution of the territory grid used to calculate borders. Higher values produce more precise borders at the cost of rebuild performance. [Default: 150]
Writes detailed diagnostic information to KingdomBorders.log in the Configs folder. Disable to avoid unnecessary disk writes. [Default: disabled]
Number of smoothing iterations applied to border corners. Higher values produce smoother curves but increase geometry and rebuild cost. [Default: 3]
